scope: Alt opens the screen's menu again, and Thunderbird shows your newest mail.

topics.title: Alt tells you why
details: If a screen has no Alt menu, Alt tells you so.
If a question is waiting, Alt asks you to answer it first. Press Y for yes or N for no.

topics.title: Alt menus
details: Press Alt to open the menu for the screen you are on, like the Email menu.
Before, Alt opened the Windows window menu instead. That is fixed on every screen.
Alt+Space still opens the Windows window menu, to move or close the window.

topics.title: Newest Thunderbird mail
details: Thunderbird mail now shows your newest messages. Gmail in Voice Companion already did.
Before each list, Thunderbird checks your mail server for new mail. This takes a few seconds at most.
If it cannot check, you hear why and what to do. Press F5 or say refresh messages to try again.
The Voice Companion add-on in Thunderbird updates by itself. You do not need to do anything.
